rows.text: Headed 'В Кремле состоялась церемония вступления Владимира Путина в должность Президента России' and stamped 7 May 2004, 13:30, the item reports the ceremony in the Andreyevsky Hall of the Grand Kremlin Palace: after taking the oath to the people of Russia Vladimir Putin addressed the citizens, then reviewed the Presidential Regiment on Cathedral Square.
